provider: CUHK Risk Management Science Programme 2025-26 Study Scheme and current Course List
academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2025-26; reviewed for 2026 entry on 2026-07-30
note: The official 2025-26 Study Scheme publishes two 72-unit Major paths. The regular Risk Management Science path contains a 9-unit Faculty Package, 42 units of Required Courses and 21 units of Elective Courses; its five-course main elective choice must include at least two RMSC courses and ends with one of RMSC4102 or RMSC4202. The Risk Analytics Stream contains the same 9-unit Faculty Package, 48 units of Required Courses and 15 units of Elective Courses; it adds two CSCI choice groups, requires two courses from a CSCI/ENGG pool and two from the named RMSC/STAT pool, and ends with one of RMSC4112 or RMSC4212. RMSC3001 may substitute for FINA3080 in either path. This supplement exposes all 16 RMSC courses in the Programme's current official Course List, whose titles and per-course units are closed by the same official page and Study Scheme. The Study Scheme also names closed ACCT, CHEM, CSCI, DOTE, ECON, ENGG, FINA, HTMG, LSCI, MATH, MGNT, PHYS and STAT pools, but the RMSC Course List does not publish their titles and individual units; those cross-department rows, the University Core, free electives and the separate CUHK-Edinburgh transfer pattern are not imported here. The resulting RMSC-only list is intentionally browse-only and must not be presented as a complete 72-unit graduation audit or produce a completion percentage.
